description: Turn an English relative date phrase into an exact calendar date: "next Tuesday", "in 3 weeks", "10 business days from today", "third Friday of March 2027", "last day of February 2028". Returns the date, weekday, how the phrase was read and alternative readings for ambiguous phrases. Use this instead of doing calendar math in your head. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

locale.description: Page language for links, e.g. en, ko, ja, es, de. Default en; falls back to English when a tool has no page in that language. Available: en, ja, ko, en-IN, id, ar, tr, ms, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, pl, nl, vi, th, zh-CN, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur, fa, uk, ro, cs, hu, el, sv, fil, he, sw, af, ckb, bg, da, nb, ta, zu, kab, sk, az, fi, lv, ne, is, ht, tpi, uz, kk, ky, be, am, sq, ka, sr, km, lo, si, hr, sl, et

tz.description: IANA time zone used for "today" when ref is omitted, e.g. America/New_York

name: relative_date
title: Resolve a relative date
